title: AIbankDomain
description: Canonical domain model for the AIbank white-label digital onboarding platform. Single source of truth — Go, TypeScript, and Python types are derived from this. v1.1.0 — расширение для 10-этапной формы онбординга (см. docs/onboarding-form-spec.md). Add-only: новые $defs и optional-поля; required-массивы существующих сущностей не меняются.

PrequalificationCheckId.description: PrequalificationCheck identifier with prefix prq_ (см. этап 1 формы онбординга)

LegalEntityProfileId.description: LegalEntityProfile identifier with prefix lep_ (расширенная анкета юрлица — этап 2)

ApplicationActivityId.description: ApplicationActivity identifier with prefix aac_ (этап 3 — AML-сведения о деятельности)

RepresentativeId.description: Representative identifier with prefix rep_ (ЕИО или представитель — этап 4)

ScreeningResultSetId.description: ScreeningResultSet identifier with prefix scr_ (этап 7 — сводный набор AML-проверок)

MonitoringProfileId.description: MonitoringProfile identifier with prefix mon_ (этап 10 — параметры постоянного мониторинга)

INN10.description: Taxpayer identification number — exactly 10 digits for legal entities

INN12.description: Individual taxpayer number — exactly 12 digits for natural persons

OGRN.description: Primary state registration number — exactly 13 digits

KPP.description: Tax registration reason code — exactly 9 digits

SNILS.description: Insurance number of individual personal account — exactly 11 digits

AccountNumber.description: 20-digit account number per the Russian bank account plan

PhoneRU.description: Russian phone number in E.164 format: +7 followed by 10 digits

OKVED.description: OKVED2 economic activity code — XX, XX.XX, or XX.XX.XX

OPFCode.description: ОКОПФ — legal organisational form code (5 digits, e.g. 12300 = ООО)

ApplicationStatus.description: State machine status for an onboarding application

DocumentType.description: Semantic category of an uploaded document. Расширено в v1.1.0 для покрытия этапа 6 формы (см. docs/onboarding-form-spec.md). Add-only: старые значения сохранены.

LegalForm.description: Legal organisational form of a Russian entity

LegalEntityStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a legal entity from the state register

Recommendation.description: Model recommendation based on risk score

DecisionType.description: How and in which direction the decision was made

AccountType.description: Functional type of a bank account. Add-only: расширено в v1.1.0 для покрытия этапа 9 (settlement/special/foreign_currency/escrow/nominal — см. docs/onboarding-form-spec.md §9).

SignatureType.description: Type of electronic signature on a document

UBONodeType.description: Type of node in the beneficial ownership graph

TaxRegime.description: Tax regime applicable to a Russian legal entity / IP

AuthorityBasis.description: Legal basis on which the representative acts on behalf of the legal entity (этап 4)

IDDocumentType.description: Type of identity document presented by a representative / UBO

PDLCategory.description: Politically-exposed-person category — uses PEP terminology in regulatory texts

PDLRelation.description: How the person relates to a politically-exposed-person status

BusinessRiskCategory.description: AML risk category of the declared OKVED activity (этап 3)

ControlBasis.description: Basis on which a person controls the legal entity (UBO — этап 5)

ScreeningMatchLevel.description: Screening match outcome against a watch list

TariffPlan.description: Free-form tariff plan code from the bank's catalogue (e.g. 'business_lite')

MonitoringFrequency.description: Months between scheduled KYC refreshes (3/6/12 — выбор зависит от risk_level)

KYCRefreshTrigger.description: Event that triggers re-execution of KYC procedures

SigningMethod.description: Method used to sign account-opening agreements

RemoteBankingChannel.description: Channel through which DBO (remote banking) is accessed

ZSKLight.description: ЗСК (Знай своего клиента) traffic-light category from CBR

PrequalificationDecision.description: Aggregated decision after the pre-qualification stage (этап 1)

RiskFactor.description: A single factor contributing to a risk score

value.description: Observed value of the factor (any scalar)

impact.description: Signed integer contribution to the overall score (positive = higher risk)

explanation.description: Human-readable explanation of how this factor affects the score

UBONode.description: A node (person or legal entity) in the beneficial ownership graph

person_id.description: Reference to Person entity — present when node_type is person

legal_entity_id.description: Reference to LegalEntity — present when node_type is legal_entity

direct_stake.description: Direct ownership stake as a percentage (0–100)

effective_stake.description: Computed effective (indirect + direct) ownership stake as a percentage

is_ubo.description: True when effective_stake >= 25% (ultimate beneficial owner threshold)

UBOEdge.description: A directed ownership edge between two nodes in the beneficial ownership graph

stake.description: Ownership stake on this edge as a percentage

document_id.description: Supporting document that evidences this ownership stake

StructuredAddress.description: Structured address per ФИАС, used in legal/actual/postal address blocks (этап 2) and для физлица (этап 4).

postal_code.description: Postal index (free-form to support non-RU formats)

region_code.description: ФИАС region code — applicable for RU

MoneyAmount.description: Monetary amount in a specific currency

amount.description: Decimal amount (precision should match currency convention)

ContactInfo.description: Contact details for a legal entity (этап 2)

LicenseInfo.description: Licence held by a legal entity (этап 2)

Counterparty.description: Top supplier or top buyer counterparty (этап 3)

IDDocument.description: Identity document for a representative or UBO (этап 4/5)

series.description: RU passport series (4 digits) — null for non-RU

department_code.description: RU department code (XXX-XXX) — null for non-RU

ForeignerInfo.description: Additional details required for non-RU citizens (этап 4)

residence_doc_type.description: Type of legal-stay document: РВП / ВНЖ / виза

position.description: Position of the PEP — required when is_pdl=true

OwnershipChainLink.description: Single hop in the ownership chain leading to a UBO (этап 5)

level.description: Depth of the link, 1 = direct parent

entity_inn_or_reg_number.description: INN for RU entities, foreign registration number otherwise

us_person.description: True if subject is US person under FATCA

ScreeningResult.description: Outcome of a single watch-list screen (этап 7)

list_name.description: Identifier of the watch list, e.g. 'OFAC_SDN', 'EU_CFSP', 'UK_HMT', 'ROSFINMON_TERROR'

MonitoringRule.description: 375-П / per-tenant monitoring rule applied to the account (этап 10)

TransactionLimits.description: Per-operation-type limits applied at account opening (этап 8/9)

AccountAgreements.description: Bundle of consents and agreements signed at account opening (этап 9)

ukep_certificate_serial.description: Serial number of the UKEP certificate — required when signing_method=ukep

Tenant.description: A bank that uses the AIbank platform. Root multi-tenant entity — every other entity belongs to exactly one Tenant.

slug.description: Kebab-case unique identifier used in URLs and config paths

status.description: Lifecycle status of the tenant account

config_version.description: Semver of the tenant configuration currently applied

Application.description: A single onboarding application. Core state-machine entity — one per legal entity from draft to account opening or rejection.

legal_entity_id.description: Legal entity under review (nullable until entity is created)

workflow_id.description: Temporal workflow execution ID tracking this application

submitted_at.description: When the applicant submitted the application (left draft state)

decided_at.description: When a final approve/reject decision was recorded

account_id.description: Opened account — null until status is completed

Person.description: Any natural person in the system: applicant, director, founder, UBO, signatory.

birth_place.description: Place of birth as printed on the identity document (этап 4)

passport_issued_at.description: Date the passport was issued, UTC ISO 8601

id_document.description: Generalised identity document (passport_ru / passport_foreign / refugee). Дублирует passport_* поля для не-RU граждан (этап 4). Add-only — старые passport_* остаются required.

foreigner_info.description: Migration card / residence permit — для иностранцев (этап 4)

fatca_declaration.description: FATCA / CRS declaration — required для UBO (этап 5)

LegalEntity.description: A Russian legal entity (ООО, АО, etc.) undergoing or having completed onboarding.

legal_address.description: Registered legal address as plain text (legacy). Структурированный аналог — в LegalEntityProfile.

actual_address.description: Actual operating address — nullable if same as legal_address

ceo_person_id.description: Reference to the Person who is the current CEO/director

profile_id.description: Extended profile populated during onboarding (этап 2). Add-only optional reference.

LegalEntityProfile.description: Расширенная анкета юрлица (этап 2). Дополняет LegalEntity полями, которые собираются при онбординге, но не входят в core-сущность ЕГРЮЛ. Связь — через LegalEntity.profile_id.

okved_main_v2.description: Validated OKVED2 main code (XX.XX.XX). Дублирует LegalEntity.okved_primary в structured формате.

ApplicationActivity.description: AML-сведения о деятельности заявителя (этап 3). Один-к-одному к Application.

Representative.description: Единоличный исполнительный орган (ЕИО) или иной представитель юрлица (этап 4). Person хранит персональные данные, Representative — связь с заявкой и полномочия.

is_signatory.description: True если лицо имеет право подписи финансовых документов

PrequalificationCheck.description: Результат предварительной проверки по ИНН/ОГРН/short_name (этап 1) — агрегирует ответы внешних источников и финальное решение proceed/manual/reject.

short_name_hint.description: Заявленное короткое наименование — сравнивается с ЕГРЮЛ для контроля соответствия

ScreeningResultSet.description: Набор сводных AML-проверок по заявке (этап 7). Включает санкции/PEP/adverse media по всем лицам + фрод-сигналы.

turnover_realism_score.description: Реалистичность планируемых оборотов vs ОКВЭД и численность

MonitoringProfile.description: Параметры постоянного мониторинга открытого счёта (этап 10). Создаётся одновременно с Account.

items.description: Идентификатор канала уведомлений (email / siem / kafka-topic / etc.)

UBOGraph.description: Computed beneficial ownership graph for one legal entity in the context of an application.

nodes.description: All persons and entities in the ownership chain

ownership_chains.description: Линейные цепочки владения (этап 5). Add-only поле — расчёт может ленивым образом подтягивать из nodes/edges.

eio_as_ubo_confirmation.description: Подтверждение что ЕИО автоматически признан УБО (этап 5)

Document.description: A document uploaded by the applicant or retrieved from an external source.

filename.description: Original filename as provided by the uploader

checksum_sha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 checksum of the file content

extracted_fields.description: Key-value pairs extracted by OCR/ML — schema varies by document_type

ocr_confidence.description: Overall OCR confidence score (0–1); null when not yet processed

signed_at.description: When the document was electronically signed — null if unsigned

RiskAssessment.description: ML-based risk scoring result for an onboarding application.

score.description: Risk score from 0 (lowest risk) to 100 (highest risk)

factors.description: Ordered list of factors that contributed to the score

model_version.description: Semver of the risk model that produced this assessment

monitoring_profile_id.description: Связанный профиль мониторинга — заполняется на этапе 8 при выборе режима наблюдения

Decision.description: The final underwriting decision on an onboarding application.

actor_id.description: User ID of the operator for manual decisions; null for automated decisions

risk_assessment_id.description: The risk assessment that informed this decision

Account.description: A bank account opened for the legal entity after an approved application.

bank_name.description: Name of the bank holding the account

abs_reference.description: Internal reference identifier in the bank's core banking system (АБС)

monitoring_profile_id.description: Профиль постоянного мониторинга, привязанный к счёту (этап 10)

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor: a user ID, 'system', or an AI agent name

resource_type.description: Domain entity type that was affected, e.g. 'application', 'document', 'decision'

payload.description: Domain-specific event payload; schema varies by event_type

ip_address.description: IP address of the request origin — null for system-generated events
